55641.summary: The class is a debate opening session where Mr. Ross Clifford affirms that Jesus is God, co-equal with the Father, using passages from the Gospels and New Testament to support his argument. Mr. Rick O'Connor from the Christadelphian side denies the doctrine of the Trinity, emphasizing the Bible's clear teaching that the Father is the only true God and Jesus is His son.

55642.summary: The class is a public debate session focusing on the nature of Christ and the Trinity, with questions and answers exchanged between opposing viewpoints. The main discussion revolves around the divinity of Christ and the attributes of God.
